_comment: Merklane custom translation glossary — ANNOTATED TEMPLATE. Copy to config/translation-glossary.json (same directory) and edit freely; the app re-reads the active file every 60 s, no restart needed. A built-in Web3 glossary (DeFi, TVL, AMM, DAO, NFT, On-chain, Layer 2, Yield farming, …) is ALWAYS active underneath — this file is merged over it, term by term, so you only add overrides. Value formats: (1) a plain string = the same replacement in EVERY language; an identity value like "On-chain": "On-chain" simply protects the term from being translated; (2) an object = per-language replacements, where "*" is the fallback for every language you did not list; (3) an empty string for one language = do NOT protect it there, let LibreTranslate translate it naturally. Identity-mapped terms keep the casing found in the text ('on-chain' stays 'on-chain', 'On-chain' stays 'On-chain').
